newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady to up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady to up.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mostly steady to higher on Monday as dealers in several locations across the United States noted a balanced market.
"You still have a balance of supply and demand. Nobody is in a big pinch to get it (millfeeds) and noboby is in a pinch to sell it," a Minneapolis dealer said.

In the Northeast, feed demand was steady, a Buffalo dealer said. "Feedmixers are keeping their needs on a week-to-week basis," he said. "I think that is one of the reasons that has kept the nearby premiums because they are in every week, looking to buy."
He added the northeastern market may see a little extra runtime ahead of the Labor Day weekend, starting August 29.
"This may be a week where we see a little extra runtime because we are going into a long weekend after this week," he said.
Rainfall during the past three or four days in the Kansas/Oklahoma region has alleviated some parched pasture conditions lesssening the need for supplemental feeding, a Kansas dealer said.
